description: Fires when column 2 is stacked tall (about 4-6 stones, either colour) while the rest of the board is still sparse: early-to-middle game boards where many moves went into column 2. Opponent stones in columns 0, 1 and 3 suppress it most; more stones anywhere dilute it. A lone first move in column 2 also fires. A tall column 2 late in a crowded game usually does not fire.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most 0.02.
notes: Layer 0. With the last move fixed, move order does not matter (bag of stones). A col-2 stone adds about 0.5 whatever its colour. Opponent stones elsewhere subtract, mostly in cols 0 and 3; my stones are near neutral; a last move in col 5 boosts. Dev F1 0.597 (P .56 R .64, AUROC .81), sim share 0.25. The share-of-ply version got 0.54 and the 'opponent stones in col 2' version 0.14. Response is graded; many misses sit just above threshold. Hand-set weights from minimal pairs. Two synthesis positions beat the dev max (2.63, 2.64).
